note: Generated by scripts/design-system/build.mts. Do not edit by hand. Tokens are read from client/src/index.css; components come from client/src/design-system/registry.ts. Authority tiers: design/DESIGN-AUTHORITY.md.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Every clickable action. The brand variant carries the single magenta call to action on a page.
dos: Use variant="brand" for the one primary action in a section.
Use variant="outline" for secondary actions on dark fields.
Keep the visible label the same as the accessible name.
donts: Do not style a link as a button by hand; use asChild with the router Link.
Do not put two brand buttons in the same viewport.
accessibility: Sizes today are default 36px, sm 32px, lg 40px, icon 36px: below the ~44px touch target in design/DESIGN-AUTHORITY.md Tier 0. Add min-h-11 on touch-critical buttons until the sizes are reviewed.
Visible focus ring is part of the variant; do not remove it.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Short non-interactive labels: category, state, tier name.
dos: Keep labels to one or two words.
Use canonical ProActive tier names only.
donts: Do not make a badge clickable; use a Button or link.
Do not use a badge to state a metric you cannot source.
accessibility: Do not rely on colour alone to carry meaning; the text must say it.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Grouped content on a surface. Pair with the field ladder in design/UI-STYLE-RULES.md.
dos: Use one card to hold one idea.
Give every card a real heading.
donts: Do not build equal-weight grids of text-only cards; vary the lead item.
accessibility: Make the whole card one link target, not several adjacent ones.

components.name: IconWell
components.purpose: Quiet holder for a Lucide icon so the magenta accent still pops.
dos: Use Lucide icons. Generate a custom SVG only through the recraft-icons skill, with Joe's go-ahead.
donts: Do not tint the well purple.
Do not replace the mega-menu icons.
accessibility: Decorative by default; give the adjacent text the meaning.

components.name: StatusToken
components.purpose: A state label. Tier 0 because it signals truth: emerald and pulsing mean live.
dos: Use "active" and pulsing only for something that is live right now.
donts: Never animate a pulse for a system you cannot observe.
accessibility: The label text carries the state; the dot is decoration.

components.name: ProofChip
components.purpose: A small evidence label tied to design/PROOF_SYSTEM.md.
dos: Source every metric in the chip in docs/CLAIMS-REGISTER.md.
donts: No fabricated numbers, clients, certifications or response times.
accessibility: Keep contrast on both dark and paper variants.

components.name: EvidenceFrame
components.purpose: Frames a screenshot or artefact with its classification (LIVE, SANITIZED REAL, EXAMPLE, ILLUSTRATIVE).
donts: Do not frame an illustrative image as real.
accessibility: Provide alt text that says what the artefact is and its classification.

components.name: HUDFrame
components.purpose: HUD grammar for product visuals. Aesthetic is Tier 2; the truth rules inside it are Tier 0.
donts: Do not use it to imply live telemetry that is not live.
